description_short.value: Ghanaian marketer of petroleum and other energy products, with bulk import, bitumen and payments subsidiaries; about a third owned by the state.
description_short.source: Written by us from the GOIL PLC 2025 Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements (GSE PR 181/2026, report of the directors)

description_full.value: GOIL PLC markets petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. It wholly owns four subsidiaries: Goenergy Limited, a bulk importer, storer, distributor and trader of petroleum products; GOIL Upstream Limited, which works in oil and gas operations and offers consultancy across West Africa; Gobitumen Limited, which produces and sells bitumen products; and Go Financial Services Limited, licensed for electronic payments and money transfers. It also holds 60% of African Bitumen Terminal Limited, a bitumen joint venture with Societe Multinationale De Bitumes of Cote d'Ivoire. The Government of Ghana owns 34.23% of the company and private investors the rest. GOIL has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since 16 November 2007, and its head office is in Adabraka, Accra.
